correctness.rationale: The derivation identity on the alternating bracket forces D=(A,0;w,tr A) in block notation, with all six entries of A,w free, including in characteristic two. The frozen proof's explanation at lines 73–76 is imprecise: the last column need not be independent of the first two as written (take A=diag(1,0) and w=(0,1) over F₂). However, for nonzero τ=tr A, each v in ker A extends to a unique kernel vector (v,−wv/τ), proving the stated rank formula rank D=rank A+1. At τ=0 the rank rises by one exactly for w outside row(A). Counting rank-one A=uvᵗ modulo rescaling gives q²−1 of trace zero and q(q²−1) of nonzero trace. Among the q³ trace-zero matrices, q²(q−1) are nonsingular. These counts and the free row give the four stated rank coefficients. Nilpotence holds exactly when A is nilpotent, with q² choices for A and q² for w. Then D² has only the lower-left block wA. For A≠0 nilpotent the left kernel of A equals its one-dimensional row space; this gives the stated index counts and identifies the nonzero square-zero maps with the rank-one maps. Independent parameter enumerations over F₂,F₃,F₄,F₅,F₇ agreed with all coefficients; direct checks of all 512 and 19,683 linear maps over F₂ and F₃ found 64 and 729 derivations, respectively. claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Explicit aggregation: for odd q, trace-zero invertible A come from (q−1)/2 split distinct opposite-eigenvalue classes and (q−1)/2 irreducible trace-zero quadratic classes. Their class sizes q(q+1) and q(q−1) sum with those multiplicities to q²(q−1). For even q, trace zero instead selects the q−1 nonzero scalar and q−1 nonzero Jordan classes, of sizes 1 and q²−1, again q²(q−1) matrices. Thus R₃=q²(|GL₂(q)|−q²(q−1))=q³(q−1)(q²−q−1), R₁=(q²−1)(q+1), R₀=1 and R₂=q⁶−R₀−R₁−R₃. The index coefficients are the already tabulated nilpotent strata; their sum is q⁴. This proves actual coverage of both enumerators even though the prior display does not use these polynomial variables.

But the exact counts and structural observations here are obtained by summing a fully specified existing orbit table and applying elementary rank and square-zero tests to its representatives.
